theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgi_halfSpace_rigidity
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (G : Set (Rn N)) (e : Rn N), NullMeasurableSet G volume → ‖e‖ = 1 → (∀ (ζ : Rn N → ℝ) (v : Rn N), ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → inner ℝ v e = 0 → ∫ y in G, fderiv ℝ ζ y v = 0) → (∀ ζ : Rn N → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → (∀ y, 0 ≤ ζ y) → ∫ y in G, fderiv ℝ ζ y e ≤ 0) → (∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → 0 < volume (G ∩ Metric.ball 0 R) ∧ 0 < volume (Metric.ball 0 R \ G)) → volume (symmDiff G {y | 0 < inner ℝ y e}) = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
